policy: Local 1BT service taxonomy for verified live public-signal opportunity analysis. Do not read the 1BT website at runtime. Do not analyze sample, fake, or unverified leads.

buckets.use_when: Signals show hiring pressure, many engineering roles, urgent project delivery, QA roles, integration engineers, backend roles, data roles, AI developer roles, or support roles.
buckets.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the evidence is not about delivery capacity, hiring, project pressure, or technical execution needs.
buckets.example_angle: We noticed you are expanding your technical team; 1BT can provide near-term engineering capacity while hiring ramps.
buckets.evidence_needed: Live public hiring, role, or delivery-pressure evidence with source URL and excerpt.

buckets.use_when: Signals show product launch, platform build, app modernization, SaaS build, backend delivery, portals, workflow tools, or new digital products.
buckets.when_not_to_use: Do not use for generic PR, pure support, or strategy-only signals without delivery evidence.
buckets.example_angle: 1BT supports custom software/product delivery with AI-accelerated engineering.
buckets.evidence_needed: Live evidence of a product, platform, app, backend, portal, or software delivery need.

buckets.use_when: Signals show AI initiatives, automation programs, AI developer roles, AI pilots, productivity automation, agentic workflows, or intelligent process automation.
buckets.when_not_to_use: Do not use just because AI is fashionable; require concrete AI, automation, workflow, developer, or implementation evidence.
buckets.example_angle: 1BT helps teams convert AI intent into practical apps, workflows, and automation.
buckets.evidence_needed: Live evidence of AI or automation activity beyond vague PR language.

buckets.use_when: Signals show board/executive AI strategy, digital transformation agenda, exploratory AI programs, or need for AI roadmap before implementation.
buckets.when_not_to_use: Do not use for concrete engineering roles where implementation capacity is the stronger fit.
buckets.example_angle: 1BT can help turn AI ambition into a practical roadmap and delivery plan.
buckets.evidence_needed: Live evidence of strategy, executive intent, roadmap, or exploratory AI activity.

buckets.use_when: Signals show reporting dashboards, analytics products, data workflows, business intelligence, data platforms, customer analytics, or operational insights.
buckets.when_not_to_use: Do not use for generic technology news without a data, analytics, dashboard, or insight signal.
buckets.example_angle: 1BT can support data workflows, analytics, and AI-backed insight systems.
buckets.evidence_needed: Live evidence of data, reporting, analytics, dashboard, BI, or insight needs.

buckets.use_when: Signals show CRM, sales/customer service processes, claims/customer support workflows, Microsoft stack, Power Platform, Dynamics 365, ERP/finance/operations, field service, or customer data modernization.
buckets.when_not_to_use: Do not claim Dynamics, CRM, or Power Platform unless the evidence names CRM/customer workflow, Microsoft stack, or adjacent operational systems.
buckets.example_angle: 1BT supports Dynamics 365/CRM discovery, design, implementation, migration, training, support, and ongoing management.
buckets.evidence_needed: Live evidence of CRM, customer service, claims, Microsoft stack, ERP, field service, or customer-data modernization.

buckets.use_when: Signals show API engineers, middleware roles, integration projects, system connectivity, data exchange, ERP/CRM integration, payment/logistics/operations integration.
buckets.when_not_to_use: Do not use when API or integration is absent from the evidence.
buckets.example_angle: 1BT can help stabilize and accelerate integrations, APIs, and middleware delivery.
buckets.evidence_needed: Live evidence that explicitly names APIs, integrations, middleware, or system connectivity.

buckets.use_when: Signals show support load, application support hiring, production systems, operations support, customer support tooling, or need for ongoing platform management.
buckets.when_not_to_use: Do not use for build-only or strategy-only signals unless support or production operations are evident.
buckets.example_angle: 1BT can provide managed support for applications, workflows, and business systems.
buckets.evidence_needed: Live evidence of support, production, operations, or ongoing platform management pressure.

buckets.use_when: Signals show cloud platform build, SaaS scale-up, AWS/Azure requirements, serverless pipelines, deployment modernization, or cloud product engineering.
buckets.when_not_to_use: Do not use for generic web development unless cloud, SaaS, AWS, Azure, serverless, or platform scale is present.
buckets.example_angle: 1BT can support cloud product development and scalable platform delivery.
buckets.evidence_needed: Live evidence of cloud platform, SaaS, AWS, Azure, serverless, DevOps, or scalable product delivery.

buckets.use_when: Signals show QA/QE roles, test automation, API testing, BDD, performance testing, quality engineering, regression testing, or release pressure.
buckets.when_not_to_use: Do not use when quality, testing, QA, QE, or release pressure is absent.
buckets.example_angle: 1BT can strengthen QA, API testing, automation, and release confidence.
buckets.evidence_needed: Live evidence of QA, QE, test automation, API testing, or release quality pressure.

buckets.use_when: Evidence is real but weak, vague, non-IT, too junior, too general, or not clearly related to 1BT services.
buckets.when_not_to_use: Do not use if another bucket has clear, source-backed evidence.
buckets.example_angle: Do not pitch yet; monitor until stronger operational or technology evidence appears.
buckets.evidence_needed: A live source still exists, but it does not support a confident 1BT opportunity claim.
